intent: Implement Discover as a routable card brand end-to-end
overview: Merchant Services must accept Discover as a first-class routable brand across authorization, routing and settlement reconciliation. Today brand identification relies on PAN-range lookup, which cannot distinguish co-badged products; the mandate introduces an explicit brand indicator carried on the authorization message. Delivery spans the authorization parser, the routing tables, settlement reconciliation, and a certification package for the network.
